description: Implement strict Subdomain Host Routing logic at the edge isolate dispatcher.
acceptance_criteria: dispatcher.ts extracts the Host header and uses resolveHostRoute.
Apex domain requests receive an HTTP 301 Redirect to console.*.
admin.* subdomain requests without an 'admin' tier token receive an obfuscated 404 Not Found.
admin.* subdomain requests with an 'admin' tier token correctly pass through.
console.* subdomain requests route to the ASSETS binding.
api.* continues the standard DO proxy routing.

context_bundle.exact_signatures: export async function dispatchRoute(params: DispatchParams): Promise<Response>;
contract_snippets: export interface HostRouteDecision { readonly host: string; readonly subdomain: EdgeSubdomain; }
context_bundle.implementation_notes: Call resolveHostRoute(request.headers.get('host') || '') early in dispatchRoute. Use the HostRouteDecision to gate behavior. Return `Response.redirect('https://console.key-col.axe08.tech', 301)` for apex.
test_scenarios: Admin host with non-admin token returns 404
Admin host with admin token passes

description: Enforce Phase 2 Anti-Sybil Elevation Gate in GitHub OAuth Callback.
acceptance_criteria: Rejects tier promotion if account is < 60 days old.
Validates activity level to ensure > 15 public commits.
Calculates SybilProofResult and conditionally assigns tier (probationary, builder, max).
Strips internal tiers ('ultra', 'admin') from the JSON payload in handleSyncSession.

context_bundle.exact_signatures:
export async function handleOAuthGithubCallback(request: Request, env: WorkerEnv): Promise<Response>;
export async function handleSyncSession(request: Request, env: WorkerEnv): Promise<Response>;
contract_snippets: export interface SybilProofResult { readonly layer1AccountAgeDays: number; readonly layer1Passed: boolean; }
context_bundle.implementation_notes: Use fetch to the GitHub API for user data. Calculate the account age using Date.now() - new Date(profile.created_at).getTime(). For handleSyncSession, ensure the response body maps 'ultra' and 'admin' back to 'max'.
test_scenarios: Github account >= 60 days + active gets builder/max
handleSyncSession strips 'ultra' mapping to 'max' for public
